snippet.title: 2048 meets Slay the Spire | Steam demo out now!
snippet.description:
Play the demo at https://store.steampowered.com/app/4699140/Tiles__Vials_Demo/

Merge weapons, shields and potions while moving through a strategic roguelike board battler. Collect 50+ unique artifacts, create game-breaking synergies and outsmart deadly bosses.
